note: The identifiers of the stack bus of HYDRA-UMC (STACK A), of the tool head bus of URTC and the frame of the emergency stop. A message of a controller board has the identifier slot_base + slot * slot_window + offset; the emergency stop is one identifier for the whole stack, below every slot; the tool head messages are on the downlink bus of a controller board, not on STACK A, and their numbers are those of the URTC protocol (spec/can_protocol.json of URTC-COMMON). Each identifier has one emitter. The firmware, its host tools and HYDRA-UMC-TELEMETRY-COLLECTOR read this document; nothing here has run on a board. The tool head bus runs at 1 Mbit/s like STACK A (decision of the owner); legacy_bit_rate_bps is the 500 kbit/s of the earlier URTC protocol, kept as a documented value for heads not yet updated.
